notes: Traced copy of skills_guard.c cli_tools_skills_guard__load_skill_ignore's per-line parse ladder, wrapped in LIVE's two-filename loop (.skillignore then .clawhubignore). Fixture files are built identically by harness and twin at $TMPDIR/wcup_skills_guard_g2 outside the traced path. Twin's B3 (empty after CRLF strip) is constant-False because Python strip() subsumes it — mirrored so event streams align. The C port reads a single caller-supplied file and returns counts — it has no counterpart of LIVE's ignore() matcher closure (fnmatch/dir rules); that surface is ungated.
